summary: Iteration 6 verified the new Reset All dialog + resetSuppliedLists behavior. All 9 frontend scenarios pass at 390x844 against the preview URL. Validation guard: top-reset-all-btn with missing vessel/skipper/callsign shows top-validation-bar and does NOT open reset-all-dialog. Dialog shows exactly 3 bullet points inside reset-all-explainer; reset-all-cancel-btn closes without changes. On Leaving Dock after deleting item 1 (Tidy lines), editing item 2 to 'MODIFIED FURLER', adding 'CUSTOM EXTRA ITEM' and ticking item 3 -> reset-all-confirm-btn restores exactly the 16 original items with original wording, 0 ticks, custom item gone. After deleting all 6 Head (Toilet) items and the list itself, Reset All restores Head at its DEFAULT_REGISTRY position (between Provisions and Engine Service) with the 6 original items. Note: review_request wording 'after Engine Service' is slightly off — defaults.js places head BEFORE engineService (index 7 vs 8); the implementation correctly follows DEFAULT_REGISTRY order via insertDefaultList. Custom 'Dinghy' list with 2 items and 1 tick remains untouched after Reset All. My To Do List (Todo A/Todo B with flag on B and tick on A) remains untouched after Reset All. Ship's Log edits (item 87 relabeled 'LOG CUSTOM ENTRY'), added 'Extra log entry' and tick are all preserved after Reset All. State persists across page reload AND syncs to cloud: GET /api/boats/{device_id} returns 200 with the full registry including restored Head and user-created Dinghy, deleted_lists=[], leavingDock has 16 items. Regression on My To Do List: flag/up/down buttons still render (2 of each for 2 items) and function (move-down swaps rows). No horizontal overflow at 390px. No React warnings or new console errors (only pre-existing 404s for favicon/manifest).
critical_code_review_comments: defaults.js resetSuppliedLists correctly composes restoreDeletedLists then re-copies DEFAULT_DATA for every system list except PRESERVED_LISTS (shipsLog, myTodo). Uses deep JSON clone — safe but O(n) per list; fine at this scale.

PRESERVED_LISTS is a module-level constant and only referenced in resetSuppliedLists; good single source of truth. If a future supplied list should also be preserved (e.g., engine_log sibling), add it here.
insertDefaultList uses the index of the FIRST 'later' id present in current registry, so restore ordering is robust even when multiple adjacent system lists are deleted together.
ResetAllDialog uses radix AlertDialog so cancel/confirm are mutually exclusive and overlay dismiss is intercepted correctly; onOpenChange(o)=>!o&&onClose() prevents stray calls on open.
BoatPrep.reset()/confirmReset() is simple and side-effect-free; toast message matches spec exactly ('Supplied lists reset to their original items').

Minor: review_request feature list wording says Head returns 'after Engine Service' but DEFAULT_REGISTRY actually places Head BEFORE Engine Service (idx 7 vs 8). Implementation follows registry correctly; the request description just has the ordering reversed.
